title: Head of Data Management - Managing Director (NY)
desc: Position Title: Head of Data Management - Managing Director (NY) Entity: KBRA Holdings, LLC Employment Type: Full-time Location: New York, New York, United States Summary/Overview : KBRA is seeking a senior leader to head our Data Management organization. Based in New York and reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this individual will be responsible for defining and executing KBRA's enterprise data management strategy, leading Data Operations, advancing data governance and quality, and helping unlock the commercial value of KBRA's data assets. The role will work across analytical, business, product, and technology teams to establish how KBRA's data is organized, governed, curated, maintained, and made available for internal and external use. This is a highly visible leadership position requiring both strategic thinking and a willingness to engage directly in the details. About the Job: The Head of Data Management will establish the operating model, standards, and capabilities necessary to manage KBRA's data as a strategic enterprise asset. You will lead the Data Operations organization and oversee disciplines including data stewardship, master and reference data management, taxonomy and ontology development, data quality, and data-provider management. Working closely with Engineering and Product, you will help establish scalable data models, standards, processes, and technology capabilities that make KBRA's data easier to discover, integrate, govern, and use. You will also partner with business leadership to identify opportunities to package and commercialize KBRA's proprietary data assets and to ensure those assets are supported by appropriate governance, quality, and operational processes. What You'll Do: Define and execute KBRA's enterprise data management strategy and operating model. Lead and develop the Data Operations organization, including data stewardship, master/reference data management, data quality, taxonomy, and related disciplines. Manage day-to-day operational delivery, service levels, controls, escalation and capacity planning. Establish standards for the organization, classification, definition, ownership, and lifecycle management of KBRA data. Continue to mature KBRA’s data governance and data quality programs by establishing measurable standards for accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and exception management. Establish and maintain an enterprise data-domain model, including data owners, stewards, authoritative sources, definitions, quality and lifecycle. Lead the development of taxonomies, ontologies, common definitions, and canonical data concepts across KBRA. Partner with Engineering and Product on data architecture, data catalog/glossary development, metadata management, lineage, integration standards, and platforms supporting enterprise data management. Ensure ratings-related data management processes, controls, lineage, and documentation meet applicable regulatory and audit expectations. Serve as a senior point of contact for regulators, auditors, and other stakeholders on matters related to ratings data management and operations. Partner with business leaders to identify, evaluate, and develop opportunities to commercialize KBRA's proprietary data assets. Identify, evaluate, and onboard third-party data providers that improve the quality, coverage, efficiency, or automation of KBRA's data processes. Evaluate and implement technology that automates and augments data ingestion, curation, matching, enrichment, stewardship, and quality management. Establish KPIs and operating metrics for data quality, operational performance, stewardship, and data-management effectiveness. Ensure KBRA's data assets are discoverable, well-defined, governed, traceable, and of sufficient quality to support artificial intelligence, machine learning, semantic search, advanced analytics, and other emerging data-driven capabilities. Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing data management organization

title: Founding Engineer, Consumer Apps
desc: ABOUT PLACER.AI:   Placer.ai is transforming how organizations understand the physical world. Our location analytics platform provides unprecedented visibility into locations, markets, and consumer behavior. Placer empowers thousands of customers—from Fortune 500 companies, to local governments and nonprofits— to make smarter, data-driven decisions. What sets us apart? We've built the most advanced location intelligence platform in the market while maintaining an uncompromising commitment to privacy, proving that powerful analytics and responsible data practices can coexist. Our growth reflects the market's demand: we reached $100M in annual recurring revenue within just 6 years of launching, achieved unicorn status with a $1B+ valuation in 2022, and continue to expand rapidly as one of North America's fastest-growing tech companies. We're creating a $100B+ market opportunity, and we're just getting started. Named one of Forbes America's Best Startup Employers and a Deloitte Technology Fast 500 company, we're building a culture where innovation thrives, collaboration is the norm, and every team member contributes to reshaping how the world understands location. SUMMARY: The Founding Engineer, Consumer Apps is the first engineer on Placer's new B2C team. Placer's core business sells to companies. This team builds products for consumers directly: apps whose users choose to contribute the data behind the Placer platform. The role works directly with the Vice President, Consumer Apps. It owns the technical product end to end: the mobile apps and the experience inside them, the backend behind them, the permission and consent flow, and the integration that brings what users contribute into the Placer platform. The team is small and lean by design, gets its speed from AI tools, and runs on move fast, fail fast: ship small, measure honestly, and quickly either drop an idea or double down on it. The Founding Engineer takes the product from first prototype to launch and scale, and sets the technical foundation the team builds on as it grows. RESPONSIBILITIES: Architect, build and ship Placer's first consumer apps on Android and iOS, plus the backend services behind them, as the team's first engineer, on an architecture that can scale to millions of users. Own the quality of the consumer experience: onboarding, the permission ask, the core engagement loop and every screen in between. Treat each step as a place a user can drop off, work hands-on from mockups to polished UI, and use funnel data and user feedback to decide what to fix next. Build the permission and consent flow to App Store and Google Play policy, in partnership with Legal and Privacy. This covers prominent disclosure, the grant from foreground to background location, and every step of the grant funnel. Instrument the full funnel from day one, starting with attribution (which channel and campaign brought each user), then install, registration, permission grant, engagement and retention. Every drop-off should be measurable. Own measurement and experimentation: the analytics and A/B testing setup, how each experiment is designed and read, and the funnel reporting the team makes decisions from. Ship on a move fast, fail fast cadence. Release small experiments in days, not months, measure each one against the funnel, and drop what doesn't work without getting attached to it. Own releases, store submission and review responses. Work AI-first. Use AI coding, design and testing tools as the default way to build, so a small, lean team ships at the pace of a much larger one. Embed Placer's existing data collection technology in the apps. Work with R&D and Data Science so the data reaches the Placer platform through its privacy pipeline, fit for use, with identifiable data separated at the point the privacy design requires. title: AI Architect
desc: About the role: At Rubrik IT, we are transforming how the enterprise thinks and operates — building a "thinking enterprise" where intelligent, agentic systems reason across our data, tools, and workflows to drive speed, quality, and measurable business impact. As an AI Architect, you will be a pivotal technical leader driving AI Native solutions that make this vision real. You will operate where AI innovation, top-tier engineering, and business outcomes converge, acting as the technical bridge between complex business problems and cutting-edge AI execution. Leveraging our robust Enterprise AI Platform, you will translate ambiguous problems into concrete AI solution designs and ensure their successful deployment and measurable impact. This role is designed for systems-thinkers and orchestrators with an AI-first mindset — leaders who move fluidly between hands-on building  AI  solutions, and who know how to harness model APIs, data sources, and workflow layers to build practical technology that serves the business. What you'll do: Lead applied AI solution design and architecture, breaking down ambiguous business problems into concrete, actionable AI solution designs. Contribute to the detailed design of large-scale, distributed AI/ML systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and security. Design and improve retrieval, prompting, tool-calling, and orchestration patterns for internal use cases such as knowledge assistants, workflow automation, and decision support. Champion and enforce design standards, patterns, and best practices for scalable and secure development of AI applications across teams. Drive the hands-on development and implementation of key AI components, supporting both traditional and Generative AI model development and deployment. Build and deploy AI-enabled internal workflows that connect enterprise systems, data sources, model APIs, and automation layers. Leverage AI-assisted development to accelerate implementation, bringing a strong 'editor' mindset to ruthlessly audit, review, and secure AI-generated code against our standards for reliability, security, observability, and documentation. Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of MLOps pipelines, including automated model training, versioning, deployment, and monitoring. Develop and maintain evaluation approaches for output quality, retrieval accuracy, latency, and failure modes, and use findings to improve system performance over time. Help identify where human review, controls, and escalation paths are required to support responsible deployment of AI-enabled systems. Apply sound engineering judgment to balance speed, usability, risk, and maintainability in production and near-production environments. Proactively collaborate with executive leadership, data science, engineering, and product stakeholders to translate business use-cases into scalable AI solutions. Lead rigorous problem formulation by partnering with R&D,, Security, Data, HR, Finance, and business stakeholders — ensuring we apply AI to the right problems before translating needs into scalable technical solutions. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and hands-on experimentation. Contribute reusable components, playbooks, and patterns that reduce duplicate effort and improve speed across the engineering environment. Technical architecture and AI implementations directly to measurable business outcomes, recognizing that technology serves the business. Actively research and evaluate cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, algorithms, and models to identify opportunities for platform enhancement and new solution development. Experience you'll need: 10+ years of core Software/Systems Engineering architecture experience, including 4+ years dedicated to building and deploying applied AI/ML systems in production.
